#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, b;
    if (!(cin >> n >> b)) return 0;

    vector<int> arr1(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr1[i];
    }

    vector<int> pf1(n, 0);
    vector<int> pf2(n, 0);
    int sum1 = 0, sum2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr1[i] % 2 == 0) {
            sum1++;
        } else {
            sum2++;
        }
        pf1[i] = sum1;
        pf2[i] = sum2;
    }

    int prev = 0;
    vector<int> arr(n, 0);
    int p = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i += 2) {
        int x, y;
        if (prev == 0) {
            x = pf1[i];
            y = pf2[i];
        } else {
            x = pf1[i] - pf1[prev];
            y = pf2[i] - pf2[prev];
        }
        if (x == y) {
            arr[p] = std::abs(arr1[i+1] - arr1[i]);
            p++;
        }
    }

    vector<int> val(p, 1);
    vector<vector<int>> K(p + 1, vector<int>(b + 1, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= p; ++i) {
        for (int w = 0; w <= b; ++w) {
            if (i == 0 || w == 0) {
                K[i][w] = 0;
            } else if (arr[i-1] <= w) {
                K[i][w] = std::max(val[i-1] + K[i-1][w - arr[i-1]], K[i-1][w]);
            } else {
                K[i][w] = K[i-1][w];
            }
        }
    }

    cout << K[p][b] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
